objective: Add bounded scale-in authority to already-open winning Pump/Pons directional positions only after fresh thesis confirmation, without creating a new lane, resetting risk state, or weakening any entry/execution/safety control.

economic_parameters.note: One bounded add after +100% high-water, first realization, persistence, fresh requalification and all existing execution/safety gates. No second add is authorized.

accounting_requirements: Persist scale-in as an append-only native economic event on the existing lifecycle.
Track added quantity, added basis, fees/costs, quote identity, generation, and capacity telemetry separately from the original lot.
Maintain aggregate remaining quantity and aggregate remaining basis while preserving lot-level provenance.
Shared sleeve reservation authority must atomically increase held capital before the native add can commit and release only on proven failure/terminal accounting.
Common portfolio accounting must map the event to the same canonical lifecycle and record added basis rather than a second trade.
risk_requirements: An add cannot erase a prior high-water mark, deterioration streak, realization state, stop state, or pending exit intent.
Post-add exits operate on the aggregate remaining position while preserving exact lot/basis accounting.
Partial realization semantics must define whether original and added lots are reduced pro-rata or by a deterministic lot rule before promotion.
Total worst-case loss after the add must remain inside a separately certified position/lane risk ceiling.
If fresh validation fails between scale decision and commit, fail closed and retain the original position without modification.
research_instrumentation: Record every scale-eligible observation even while allocation authority is false.
Preserve fresh gate values/distances, executable add quote, 1x/2x execution stress, proposed added basis, and total-basis risk.
Measure counterfactual incremental P&L versus the unchanged no-add position at 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h, and terminal settlement.
Separate value from larger winner capture versus additional drawdown/fee/slippage cost.
required_proofs: Restart/replay reconstructs original and added lots, aggregate basis, risk state, and sleeve reservation identically.
Repeated scale decision/event delivery is idempotent and cannot double-add.
A scale event cannot occur after a durable full-exit intent.
Unrealized profit may satisfy a scale signal but does not increase realized-equity sizing authority.
The add is downsize-only under turnover/depth/stress/breadth constraints.
A failed add quote/commit leaves the pre-add position and risk state byte-equivalent.
Current/Survivor shared-sleeve fencing prevents another regime from double-spending the added capital.
promotion_requirements: Do not implement in the active Stage E/F/G lineage.
After final machinery certification, compose against the exact final machinery SHA.
Use right-tail-capture-v1 as the frozen initial economic calibration; collect prospective shadow/market evidence after composition and treat any later parameter change as a new policy/cohort.
First realization must precede scale; no new post-add partial is introduced in v1. Any future post-add partial requires a separately frozen deterministic pro-rata lot rule or certified successor.
Run native ledger, shared sleeve, portfolio accounting, restart/replay, duplicate-event, exit-state, and execution-capacity tests.
Run exact-SHA non-market certification before any PAPER market smoke.
Restart affected profitability cohorts because economic exposure changes.
